messages:
mira: Quick sync — I opened a proposal for tightening the JSON logging pipeline for GPU fleet telemetry. TL;DR: add stable fields for GPU metadata, standardize sampling tags, and enforce PII redaction before ingest. Want buy-in before I file the infra change.
sam: Can you paste the proposed schema? how aggressive is sampling? :eyes:
mira: Sure — short excerpt:
```json
{
  "ts": "iso8601",
  "level": "info|error",
  "service": "gpu-agent",
  "node": { "id": "", "region": "", "az": "" },
  "gpu": { "model": "", "count": 0, "util_pct": 0.0, "temp_c": 0 },
  "workload": { "job_id": "", "app": "", "owner": "team-name" },
  "privacy": { "sample_key": "sampling-v1", "redacted": true }
}
```
mira: Sampling plan: 1% full payload for all nodes, 10% for nodes hitting gpu.util_pct > 85% or GPU memory > 90%; top-level field `privacy.sample_key` indicates sample bucket so downstream can join evals without storing raw user metadata.
devon: How do we handle customer identifiers in ``workload.owner``? that's PII for private clusters.
mira: Good call. Proposal: enforce a filter that replaces anything matching customer email / account id patterns with a stable hashed id (HMAC with org key) at ingestion. Example rule: `s/([A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,})/hmac($1)/`. For private deployments we skip shipping raw but still include hashed ids.
alisha: We should make sure Kibana/Grafana queries use the hashed id consistently. Also retention needs to be spelled out — metrics vs logs retention.
mira: Right — metrics (Prometheus) unchanged. Logs: raw full payloads kept only for sampled docs (as above) and indexed for 30d; redacted/summarized events stored 365d. We'll add a `privacy.retention` tag in logs so the pipeline can enforce index lifecycle.
sam: Alert tuning: if we reduce full payload sampling, some alert rules relying on `workload.job_id` will fail. Plan to backfill synthetic IDs into alert rules or add an enrichment step?
mira: Enrichment step planned for the ingest layer: add `workload.job_type` / `workload.failure_reason` (derived, non-PII) so SLO dashboards still work. For rules needing exact job_id, we'll keep an internal high-fidelity stream (1% sample) for debugging.
oncall-bot: deploy-checklist created: https://redwood.internal/issue/INFRA-922 (checks: schema migration flag, sampler version, redaction regex tests, k8s config map rollout)
devon: How will this affect cardinality in Grafana? adding hashed ids can explode series.
mira: We won't index hashed ids as tags in Prometheus. For log-backed dashboards (Loki/ES) we'll sample the hashed ids and avoid using them as high-cardinality labels. We'll recommend dashboards use `workload.app` and `node.region` as query keys.
alisha: Can we get a small script for redaction tests? I'll run it against staging logs.
mira: Yep — sample `jq` pipeline we'll use in ingestion:
```bash
jq 'del(.user.email) | .workload.owner = ("hmac:" + (.workload.owner | ascii_downcase | sha256)) | .privacy.sample_key = (if (.gpu.util_pct > 85) then "hot-10pct" else "global-1pct" end)'
```
mira: Rollout plan:
1) Feature flag `json-log-schema-v2` for agents (2 weeks behind FF). 2) Ship redaction and sampling to staging, run 48h shadow ingestion. 3) Enable sampling/retention enforcement in pipeline and run canary on 5% of production (1 day). 4) Full rollout with monitoring + pager thresholds.
sam: Pager thresholds to add: increase error-rate budget alert for ingestion errors, and add a new Grafana panel for sampling rate vs expected, plus metric `pipeline.redaction_failures`.
mira: Agreed. Also adding SLOs: "Log completeness" (percentage of hot-spot events sampled) and "Redaction success rate" (errors/total). We'll surface in SLO dashboard and tie to runbook.
devon: Who owns the runbook and rollout window? I can take the Saturday 03:00 UTC window if that helps.
mira: Thanks — will assign you as primary for rollout. @alisha can you own the redaction test suite? @sam you'll own Grafana panels/alerts. I'll file the infra change and link docs.
alisha: On it. I'll add unit tests for regex and the jq example in the repo.
mira: One last note — telemetry for GPUs is sensitive in some regions (regulatory). We will enforce region overrides: customers in EU / APAC private deployments will default to `sample=0.1%` unless they opt-in in contract.
sam: OK. sounds good. :thumbsup:
logbot: Schema PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/logs/pull/451 — CI: redaction tests passed. :white_check_mark:
mira: Great — I'll link the PR in the infra ticket and post follow-up with the detailed runbook and observability checklist. Thanks everyone.
